chapter.title: YouTube Videos
chapter.p: Runestone uses a YouTube API that broadcasts events when a reader interacts with a video. In this way, Runestone can record video-watching as an activity. As output we concede better behavior on small screens ( responsiveness ) to enable this feature in a Runestone version. A label attribute is necessary for persistence in the Runestone database. Various features, such as playlists, are not yet supported make a request.
The margins here are asymmetric just as a test. And this text is here to see where the video ends.
